decisions.reason: As a close-to-core cloud communication feature that remained on its own page across 2023 and 2024, it likely has acceptable traction and low carrying cost, so its option value still exceeds the benefit of withdrawal.

Because this newly launched gateway fits the firm’s established secure messaging stack and is inexpensive to maintain as a software add-on, management would likely keep it while demand uncertainty resolves.

This new product is adjacent to the core offer and likely shares infrastructure and customers with existing services, so despite some portfolio crowding the firm would usually retain it for another year rather than abandon the option early.
